core_obligations: Choose an affine scheme V with a surjective etale morphism V -> Y, which exists because Y is an algebraic space (proof lines 2088-2089).
Factor the composite V -> Y -> X through some X_lambda, using the discussion following the definition (proof lines 2089-2091).
Conclude that Y -> X itself factors through that X_lambda because V -> Y is a surjection of sheaves (proof lines 2091-2092).
proof_roadmap: Cover by an affine scheme (proof lines 2088-2089).
Factor from the affine cover (proof lines 2089-2091).
Descend along the surjection of sheaves (proof lines 2091-2092).
difficulty_reason: For X = colim X_lambda as in the definition of an affine formal algebraic space and a quasi-compact algebraic space Y over S, the lemma asserts that any morphism Y -> X factors through a single X_lambda (statement lines 2079-2085). The proof chooses an affine scheme V with a surjective etale morphism V -> Y, uses the discussion following the definition to factor the composite V -> Y -> X through some X_lambda, and then concludes by surjectivity of V -> Y as a map of sheaves (proof lines 2087-2092). The level is H2: the covering reduction and the sheaf-theoretic conclusion are both displayed, and the quasi-compactness hypothesis is used at exactly the step where it enters.
